description:
The current `landing-page-desktop-upload` skill is a thin wrapper around `deployment-manager releases start` with a plain-text decision table. Agents calling it get a generic error on failure and have to guess what to do. With typed errors and a preflight endpoint in place, the skill can be upgraded so an agent using it walks the operator through every prerequisite with concrete fix commands.

Scope of work:
- Rewrite scenarios/prompt-manager/store/skills/packs/core/landing-page-desktop-upload/SKILL.md.
- New Step 1: call `deployment-manager releases preflight <profile> --commit <sha> --version <v> --platforms <list>` (once the preflight endpoint exists).
- If preflight returns any unready gates, skill instructs the agent to: render the gap report, for each failed gate present remediation_command, ask user for approval, run the fix, re-run preflight. Loop until preflight is green.
- New Step 2: `releases start` (unchanged from today).
- New Step 3: result surfacing + mid-flight failure handling. Mid-flight failures now carry typed codes, so the skill has a second remediation table for post-start failures (publish_failed, verify_mismatch, etc.) rather than only pre-start failures.
- Remove the current long fallback section; replace with a short note pointing to `deployment-manager` docs when DM itself is unavailable.
- Explicit guidance to the agent: always ask the user before running a remediation command. Never auto-run destructive operations (e.g., `scenario-to-cloud redeploy`) without approval.

Out of scope:
- Adding preflight in DM (separate item).
- Adding typed errors in DM (separate item).
- Making the agent run remediation commands without user consent.
name: landing-page-desktop-upload-guided-remediation-rewrite
title: Rewrite landing-page-desktop-upload Skill For Guided Remediation
